attributes.board_name: Maine Board of Licensure in Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1: programs by organizations accredited by AAPA, AMA, ACCME, AAFP, Maine Medical Association, AOA or Maine Osteopathic Association, plus listed publications, posters, teaching, degrees, postgraduate training; up to 50 hours Category 2
rules.alternatives: Proof of current NCCPA certification at the time the renewal application is submitted satisfies the CME requirements.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CME is prorated during the first licensure period.
rules.audit_note: Board staff perform random CME audits; certificates only if requested in an audit. Missing CME leads to an inactive-status renewal unless an extension/deferment was granted.

topics.who: All PAs: 3 hours Category 1 on prescribing opioid medication every two years (Board Rule Chapter 21)

rules.notes: Joint rule of the Board of Licensure in Medicine and the Board of Osteopathic Licensure; a PA may be licensed by either board. Online jurisprudence exam every other renewal cycle (about 4 years). License expires end of birth month, odd/even year matching birth year.
rules.legal_basis: 02-373 C.M.R. Chapter 2 (joint rule with 02-383), Section 11; Board Rule Chapter 21
